title: Shortest Way to Form String
summary: Determine the least number of subsequences from the source string needed to form the target string exactly, maintaining the order of characters.
statement: Determine the least number of subsequences from the source string needed to form the target string exactly, maintaining the order of characters. If formation is impossible, return -1.
constraints: Form target by concatenating subsequences of source.
Return the minimum number or -1 when a target character is absent.
hints: Greedily consume the earliest source position after the current one.
Store sorted occurrence indices and binary-search the next index for each target character.
When none remains, start a new source subsequence at that character’s first occurrence.
Choosing an earlier available occurrence never reduces future choices, so greedy minimizes restarts.
editorial: Choosing an earlier available occurrence never reduces future choices, so greedy minimizes restarts.
